questions.def: 'Would' is used to express the future in the past.
questions.question: I thought she ___ be late, but she arrived early.

questions.def: 'Would' is the past form of 'will' for future in the past.
questions.question: He said he ___ call me the following day.

questions.def: 'Were going' expresses a planned future action in the past.
questions.question: They believed they ___ to Europe that summer.

questions.def: Expect + object + to + infinitive for future in the past.
questions.question: We expected it ___ rain, but the sun shone brightly.

questions.def: 'Was going to' expresses intention in the past.
questions.question: I knew he ___ pass the exam with flying colours.

questions.def: 'Would meet' represents a future action from a past perspective.
questions.question: She thought she ___ him at the conference.

questions.def: 'Would' is used to express future perfect in the past.
questions.question: They assumed they ___ have finished the project by then.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses future continuous in the past (imagined future).
questions.question: I imagined they ___ be living in Paris by now.

questions.def: 'Would visit' shows a future intention from a past point of view.
questions.question: He hoped that he ___ his grandmother soon.

questions.def: 'Was' introduces a passive construction of future in the past.
questions.question: It ___ thought that the economy would improve soon.

questions.def: 'Would' is needed to maintain past tense agreement.
questions.question: He told me he ___ call as soon as he arrived.

questions.def: 'Were to do' expresses a planned future action in the past.
questions.question: We didn't know what we ___ next.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses a future event as perceived in the past.
questions.question: She felt she ___ never see him again.

questions.def: 'Would have' indicates the future perfect in the past.
questions.question: He said he ___ finished the report by Friday.

questions.def: 'Would be attending' is future continuous in the past.
questions.question: They assumed he ___ the meeting.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses anticipated future from a past perspective.
questions.question: We had hoped that the weather ___ improve.

questions.def: 'Would be' shows the future, as viewed from the past.
questions.question: She believed she ___ successful one day.

questions.def: 'Was said' introduces a passive future-in-the-past statement.
questions.question: It ___ that the company would merge.

questions.def: 'Were going to be' expresses future intention in the past.
questions.question: I was under the impression that they ___ helping us.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses a prediction from a past perspective.
questions.question: They predicted it ___ be a difficult year.

questions.def: 'Would be arriving' expresses future continuous in the past.
questions.question: He mentioned that he ___ late.

questions.def: 'Would be' expresses anticipated future situation in the past.
questions.question: We anticipated that the flight ___ delayed.

questions.def: 'Would have' indicates future perfect from a past perspective.
questions.question: I expected that he ___ called me.

questions.def: Use 'would' to express future in the past.
questions.question: I thought they ___ be late, but they arrived early.

questions.def: 'Was going to' expresses a past intention about the future.
questions.question: She said she ___ call me back later that day.

questions.def: 'Were expected' expresses a past expectation about the future.
questions.question: We ___ to finish the project by Friday.

questions.def: 'Was to' expresses a formal arrangement in the past.
questions.question: They knew she ___ be promoted soon.

questions.def: 'Were moving' expresses a past continuous action about the future.
questions.question: I heard they ___ moving to Spain the following year.

questions.def: 'Had planned' shows an intention in the past that did not happen.
questions.question: They ___ to visit Rome, but they changed their minds.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses a future action promised in the past.
questions.question: He promised he ___ help me with the presentation.
